subject: chest freezer
title: What If You Never Defrosted Your Freezer?

scenes.text: What if you never defrosted your freezer? All that ice isn't helping. It's costing you.
Each time the door opens, warm, moist air rushes in. Its water condenses and freezes onto the walls.
Over weeks and months the frost thickens. Energy Star says never let it pass a quarter of an inch.
Past that, the freezer has to work harder, and ice buildup can significantly cut its efficiency.
Thick frost can also block airflow inside, so it runs longer just to hold the same temperature.
The twist: manual defrost freezers use roughly half the energy of automatic ones. But only if you actually defrost them.
